content.title: Documentary Encounter | Rooftop Routine to Camera-Aware Farewell
content.summary: The photographer first approaches everyday people as if they were discovered by chance, and then records several simple actions at the same observation distance; external clues change the characters' goals, and the characters only respond briefly to the camera, and finally leave with a hand-held error to complete the sense of memory. As new evidence for the existing documentary encounter template, no new selector is added.

quick_start.input_format: Observer medium + everyday people/places + two everyday actions + external signal to change target + one response + motivated recording error
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original plant greenhouse at night, the photographer walked around a planting bed and found that the elderly gardener was already cleaning the condensation on the glass. He did not look at the camera during the opening scene; the service bell rang next to the side door, the gardener stopped checking and looked at the bell, and the camera took a short breath to focus; the gardener left, and the white balance drifted from fluorescent green to sodium amber. The focus did not stabilize until the door began to close, leaving an empty greenhouse.
required_anchors: Begin with an observer discovering a subject already inside an ordinary routine.
Use recurring environmental landmarks to keep several small actions in one readable geography.
Allow exactly one restrained acknowledgment of the observer.
End with departure and at least one mild operator imperfection still visible.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: The photographer first approaches everyday people as if they were discovered by chance, and then records several simple actions at the same observation distance; external clues change the characters' goals, and the characters only respond briefly to the camera, and finally leave with a hand-held error to complete the sense of memory. As new evidence for the existing documentary encounter template, no new selector is added.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Approach one subject as an unplanned discovery, observe a small routine through recurring spatial landmarks, allow one external cue or camera awareness to change the relationship, receive a single restrained acknowledgment, then follow an imperfect departure without polishing away operator error.

invariants.rule: Begin with an observer discovering a subject already inside an ordinary routine.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the opening from feeling staged for the camera.
invariants.ablation_failure: A prepared hero pose removes the discovery relationship.

invariants.rule: Use recurring environmental landmarks to keep several small actions in one readable geography.
invariants.purpose: Turns fragments into a continuous lived moment.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated close-ups lose place and routine.

invariants.rule: Let one visible external cue or growing camera awareness redirect the subject's attention.
invariants.purpose: Creates a causal change without scripted exposition.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unexplained reaction has no visible trigger.

invariants.rule: Allow exactly one restrained acknowledgment of the observer.
invariants.purpose: Changes the subject-camera relationship without becoming performance coverage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated looks or gestures make the encounter theatrical.

invariants.rule: End with departure and at least one mild operator imperfection still visible.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the memory-recording character of the footage.
invariants.ablation_failure: A flawless hero finish erases the observer's presence.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source cat, laundry, tea or domestic props
the exact rooftop location and wardrobe
